target.title: fix(mattermost): bound websocket handshake waits at 30s
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Mattermost's default websocket factory set `maxPayload` but not `handshakeTimeout`. `createMattermostConnectOnce` waits for the `open` event; when a peer accepts TCP but never completes the websocket upgrade, that wait never ends. Slack relay and browser CDP already bound handshake waits at 30s.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Keep a private `buildMattermostWebSocketClientOptions` as the single production options surface (`handshakeTimeout: 30_000`).
- Default Mattermost `WebSocket` factory consumes that builder.
- Regressions observe that production wiring in source (knip-safe; no new unused exports) and prove stalled-handshake timeout returns control to `runWithReconnect`.

No new config/env surface.

## User Impact

**Before:** A Mattermost host that accepted TCP without completing the websocket handshake could pin the channel reconnect loop forever on that attempt.

**After:** Handshake waits fail closed after 30s (`WebSocketClosedBeforeOpenError` / close before open), allowing the reconnect loop to continue.

## Evidence

- Changed: `extensions/mattermost/src/mattermost/monitor-websocket.ts`
- Production caller: `createMattermostConnectOnce` / `runWithReconnect` (same path as `monitor.ts`)
- Sibling: `extensions/slack/src/monitor/relay-source.ts` (`handshakeTimeout: 30_000`)
- Regression: `extensions/mattermost/src/mattermost/monitor-websocket.test.ts`
- ClawSweeper follow-ups addressed: production-wiring coverage + standalone timeout→reconnect output (including full 30s default-factory floor)

### Caller-path Vitest

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/mattermost/src/mattermost/monitor-websocket.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

```text
 ✓ ... > uses a 30s handshakeTimeout matching Slack relay 1ms
[mattermost handshake proof] timed_out=true name=WebSocketClosedBeforeOpenError message=websocket closed before open (code 1006)
 ✓ ... > fails connect when the websocket handshake never completes 203ms
[mattermost handshake reconnect proof] timeout_then_reconnect=true errors=WebSocketClosedBeforeOpenError,WebSocketClosedBeforeOpenError reconnect_delays_ms=50
 ✓ ... > returns control to reconnect after a stalled handshake 458ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  14 passed (14)
[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 8.05s
```

## Real behavior proof

**Commands run:**
```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/mattermost/src/mattermost/monitor-websocket.test.ts --reporter=verbose
PROOF_MODE=short node /tmp/openclaw-mattermost-handshake-proof/standalone.mjs
PROOF_MODE=default-factory node /tmp/openclaw-mattermost-handshake-proof/standalone.mjs
```

**Before fix:**
Default Mattermost `WebSocket` options had no `handshakeTimeout`, so `createMattermostConnectOnce` could wait indefinitely for `open`.

**After fix:**
Production builder wires `handshakeTimeout: 30000` into the default factory. Against a TCP peer that accepts but never upgrades:

1. Short standalone run (200ms stand-in): timeout then reconnect attempt.
2. Default-factory floor (30_000 ms): first attempt fails at ~30s, reconnect schedules, second attempt also times out.

**Evidence after fix (Vitest):**
```text
[mattermost handshake proof] timed_out=true name=WebSocketClosedBeforeOpenError message=websocket closed before open (code 1006)
[mattermost handshake reconnect proof] timeout_then_reconnect=true errors=WebSocketClosedBeforeOpenError,WebSocketClosedBeforeOpenError reconnect_delays_ms=50
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  14 passed (14)
```

**Evidence after fix (standalone, non-Vitest):**
```text
[standalone] source_builder=true source_default_factory_wiring=true production_timeout_ms=30000
[standalone] mode=short hang_tcp_peer=ws://127.0.0.1:56890 handshakeTimeout_ms=200
[standalone] connect_attempt=1
[standalone] timeout_or_error name=WebSocketClosedBeforeOpenError message=websocket closed before open (code 1006) elapsed_ms=204
[standalone] shouldReconnect attempt=0 error=WebSocketClosedBeforeOpenError elapsed_ms=205
[standalone] reconnect_scheduled delay_ms=50
[standalone] connect_attempt=2
[standalone] RESULT timeout_then_reconnect=true connect_attempts=2 errors=WebSocketClosedBeforeOpenError,WebSocketClosedBeforeOpenError reconnect_delays_ms=50 elapsed_ms=457
```

**Evidence after fix (standalone default-factory 30s floor + reconnect):**
```text
[standalone] mode=default-factory hang_tcp_peer=ws://127.0.0.1:56911 handshakeTimeout_ms=30000
[standalone] connect_attempt=1
[standalone] timeout_or_error name=WebSocketClosedBeforeOpenError message=websocket closed before open (code 1006) elapsed_ms=30004
[standalone] shouldReconnect attempt=0 error=WebSocketClosedBeforeOpenError elapsed_ms=30005
[standalone] reconnect_scheduled delay_ms=50
[standalone] connect_attempt=2
[standalone] timeout_or_error name=WebSocketClosedBeforeOpenError message=websocket closed before open (code 1006) elapsed_ms=60061
[standalone] shouldReconnect attempt=1 error=WebSocketClosedBeforeOpenError elapsed_ms=60069
[standalone] RESULT timeout_then_reconnect=true connect_attempts=2 errors=WebSocketClosedBeforeOpenError,WebSocketClosedBeforeOpenError reconnect_delays_ms=50 elapsed_ms=60069
```

**What was not tested:**
Live Mattermost Cloud/server credentials; gateway process packaging beyond the production `ws` client options + reconnect policy used by `monitor.ts`.
